newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet amid Deng fears.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet amid Deng fears.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London traded quietly in London on Tuesday amid continuing concern over the health of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was 52.89 points firmer at 13,155.83 by 1600 GMT. "The market is still quiet ahead of news of Deng," one trader said.
In Hong Kong the Hang Seng tumbled early on Tuesday on news that Deng was ill, but the index edged away from its lows to close only 41.38 points or 0.32 percent lower at 13,102.94.
Deng, 92, who retired from his last official post in 1990, has not been seen in public since 1994.
